findings.title: Verifier failures are bounded by r3's own 120-second deadline
evidence: semantic/http-006.json and http-016.json (503 after 5.163 s and 2.643 s)
docs/reports/engine-v6-o2-free-api-2026-11-08.json (26232 ms and 139 thinking tokens for a 24-token prompt)
findings.mechanism: All nine 504 responses complete within a 1.7-second band just under the client timeout. The upstream SDK source forwards the client timeout to the server as a deadline header. The verifier generation most likely did not finish inside the deadline r3 requested; overload (the two fast 503 responses) is a separate signature.
findings.falsifier: Send the retained request body with a 300-second client timeout. If it still fails near 118 s, or if the installed SDK does not send a deadline header, this reading is wrong.
findings.correction: Diagnose before changing anything (protocol E1, E2). Any change of timeout, reasoning budget or verifier model is a new candidate.
findings.closureEvidence: Two receipts per arm on two separate days selecting exactly one predeclared reading; installed-SDK source lines for the timeout header.

findings.title: The single AbortError is a harness artifact
evidence: scripts/engine-o2-live-wave.ts:58-62 (pacing delay inside the fetch wrapper)
findings.mechanism: The SDK starts its 120 s abort timer when it calls fetch. The harness then waits 9.73 s for pacing inside the wrapper, so the abort fires 110 s after the request is actually sent, before the server deadline.
findings.falsifier: A harness that paces before the SDK call and still aborts earlier than 120 s after sending.
findings.correction: Pace before invoking the SDK. Record SDK-call, first-byte and completion timestamps.
findings.closureEvidence: Receipts in which send time equals SDK-call time within milliseconds.

findings.title: Unresolved changes are re-analysed every cycle; observe mode duplicates ledger claims
evidence: src/lib/engine/pipeline.ts:287-297 (observe commit neither advances baseline nor clears candidate)
findings.mechanism: No record links a candidate hash to a completed analysis. Each policy that differs from its public baseline consumes one analyst and one verifier generation per daily cycle; in observe mode the baseline never advances, so demand grows with cumulative divergence and the ledger gains a duplicate claim set per day.
findings.falsifier: Injected-provider lab run over three cycles with unchanged source showing a single analyst call in total.
findings.correction: Key analysis and ledger rows on policy plus candidate text hash plus profile; keep a pending review stable while its evidence is current; decide how observe mode tracks an observed baseline.
findings.closureEvidence: Protocol E3 scenarios 4, 5 and 6 with call counts, on the corrected candidate.

findings.title: Deterministic failures are retried and never reach a reviewer
evidence: src/lib/engine/pipeline.ts:310-312 (only two budget codes become holds)
src/lib/engine/store.ts:266-285 (terminalFailure creates no EngineReview and keeps the candidate)
findings.mechanism: Truncated output, invalid JSON, oversize diff, oversize document and oversize artifact are deterministic at temperature 0. Each is retried three times, ends as a failed task without a review row, and repeats the next day.
findings.falsifier: Injected truncated output producing a review row or fewer than three attempts.
findings.correction: Route deterministic failures to a hold with a review row and stop retrying them; measure the largest change that fits the output cap.
findings.closureEvidence: Protocol E3 scenarios 1, 2 and 7; a measured size distribution of real diffs against the cap.

findings.title: Provider errors are erased from durable state; engine calls are outside AI telemetry
evidence: src/lib/engine (no reference to aiTelemetry or AiModelInvocation)
findings.mechanism: HTTP status, provider status and retry delay are discarded; failed-call consumption cannot be reconstructed from the database.
findings.falsifier: A durable row carrying the provider status for a failed engine model call.
findings.correction: Persist a bounded provider status code, retry delay and attempt usage per model call.
findings.closureEvidence: Lab run with injected 429, 503 and 504 showing distinct persisted codes.

findings.title: No quota- or rate-aware scheduling; token gate exceeds the observed free per-minute limit
evidence: docs/reports/engine-v6-o2-free-api-2026-11-08.json (15 and 5 requests/minute, 250,000 input tokens/minute, 500 and 20 requests/day)
findings.mechanism: A model 429 is a generic error with no use of the retry delay; three attempts can be spent against an exhausted daily quota. A document between 250,000 and 750,000 tokens passes r3's gate but cannot be served on the observed tier.
findings.falsifier: Evidence that the engine reads provider retry delays or tracks per-model request counts.
findings.correction: Per-model daily and per-minute budgets in the scheduler; hold rather than retry on quota exhaustion.
findings.closureEvidence: Protocol E3 scenario 3; Phase A and B quota accounting against the provider console.

findings.title: High-impact rule misses four of the product's six taxonomy categories and common phrasings
evidence: docs/reports/engine-v6-o2-wave2-2026-11-09/semantic/analyst-table.json (Training No to Yes, impact 5, highImpact false)
semantic/analyst-negation-exception.json (sale and consent, impact 5, highImpact false)
findings.mechanism: One regular expression over quoted source text covers arbitration and liability among the taxonomy keys, not ai_training, data_sharing, retention or content_licensing. English 'governed by the laws of' and 'terminate' do not match. A supported change scoring below 7 without a keyword is published automatically.
findings.falsifier: A structurally valid claim on an AI-training default change returning highImpact true on r3.
findings.correction: Derive mandatory-review categories from an approved list; do not rely on the model's score.
findings.closureEvidence: Protocol E5 on the corrected candidate with an approved category list.

findings.title: Model impact score is non-discriminating and crossed the review threshold for the same fact
evidence: semantic/analyst-retention.json (30 to 60 days after closure, impact 5)
semantic/analyst-*.json (five of six claims scored exactly 5)
src/lib/engine/pipeline.ts:216 and 223 (public risk from analyst score)
src/lib/engine/claims.ts:161 (verifier prompt does not cover impact)
findings.mechanism: The numeric score decides between automatic publication and human review at 7, and becomes the public risk label, without verification.
findings.falsifier: Repeated runs showing a stable score for the same change across wording variants.
findings.correction: Treat the score as advisory; route on categories; verify or drop the public risk number.
findings.closureEvidence: Repeatability measurement on a labelled set within the E6 budget.

findings.title: Date-role guard passes a false effective-date claim
findings.mechanism: The guard tests for a date keyword anywhere in the quoted spans; quoting an unchanged effective-date line satisfies it. Phrasings without the keyword are unchecked.
findings.falsifier: The same false claim rejected structurally on r3.
findings.correction: Describe it as a narrow pattern check; rely on verified semantics and human labels for date roles.
findings.closureEvidence: Date-role negatives in E6 with verdicts.

findings.title: Language is verified from publisher metadata, not content
findings.mechanism: The html lang attribute or Content-Language header is compared with the contract. A mislabelled page passes; a correct page without metadata is held.
findings.falsifier: A content-based language check in the engine path.
findings.correction: Add reviewed language to the reference manifest and a content check, or state the limit in every report.
findings.closureEvidence: E4 corpus including a mislabelled page.

findings.title: Hosted preview cannot run an unattended 500/day with r3
evidence: src/lib/__tests__/engineV6.test.ts:563-571 (500 rows sharing one URL, two fetch tasks)
findings.mechanism: Scheduler disabled on hosted preview, batches of at most 50, one active task, worker bound to the HTTP process lifetime, catalogue and configuration absent.
findings.falsifier: A hosted run on r3 enqueueing more than 50 policies or triggered by the scheduler.
findings.correction: Either a declared manual procedure of ten or more batches per day, or a new candidate with a hosted scheduler.
findings.closureEvidence: Protocol section 4 preconditions met on the intended host.

findings.title: Live worker diagnostic disabled the hosted guards
findings.mechanism: POLICYWATCHER_HOSTED_PREVIEW is deleted, so leader lease, single-task rule and hosted context assertions were not on the path that met a live model.
findings.falsifier: A retained run with the flag set and a live model call.
findings.correction: Run E7 through the permitted local production-mode rehearsal path.
findings.closureEvidence: E7 receipts with worker leadership status.

findings.title: Wave stop rule ignored repeated 5xx and timeouts
findings.mechanism: Twelve of the twenty observed daily verifier requests were spent after the first failures had already shown the route was not answering.
findings.falsifier: None needed; counts are in the receipts.
findings.correction: Stop after a declared number of consecutive non-verdict outcomes.
findings.closureEvidence: Stop rule present and asserted in the next plan.

findings.title: Receipts omit every request header
findings.mechanism: Deadline header, API version and client identity cannot be established from the evidence.
findings.falsifier: A receipt containing non-secret request headers.
findings.correction: Record headers with the credential redacted.
findings.closureEvidence: E2 receipts.

findings.title: Backup is non-transactional, whole-database in memory, verification-only and unbound to the candidate
findings.mechanism: Tables are read sequentially without a transaction; a running worker can commit between reads. Payload records application and inventory version only. No restore path exists in the module.
findings.falsifier: A completed restore whose tables equal the source at one instant, taken during worker activity.
findings.correction: Snapshot-consistent export; streaming; restore tool; bind implementation hash, migration identity and provider.
findings.closureEvidence: Protocol E8.

findings.title: No retention for artifacts, tasks, attempts or reviews; growth unmeasured
evidence: src/lib/engine/acquisition.ts:195 and 274 (raw HTML up to 5 MB stored per capture)
findings.mechanism: Each capture whose bytes differ creates a new artifact; nothing deletes any.
findings.falsifier: A pruning routine in the engine path.
findings.correction: Measure growth in Phase A; define retention that preserves ledger re-verifiability.
findings.closureEvidence: Daily database size series over Phase A.

findings.title: Readiness report omits engine configuration; PostgreSQL integrity fields are constants
findings.mechanism: Status can be 'ready' with no engine model configuration; PostgreSQL quick-check and foreign-key values are hard-coded; migrations are matched by name.
findings.falsifier: A readiness field reflecting engine model variables.
findings.correction: Report engine flags and model identities; label PostgreSQL fields as not measured.
findings.closureEvidence: Updated readiness output on a lab database.

findings.title: Ledger evidence cannot be re-verified from ledger rows alone
evidence: prisma/schema.prisma (EngineClaim has no relation to task, policy, review or change; EngineTask cascades from EngineRun)
findings.mechanism: documentHash keys no retained text; the route to the frozen document runs through EngineTask.checkpointJson, which disappears if its run is deleted.
findings.falsifier: A query that returns the frozen document for a ledger span without the task row.
findings.correction: Store the artifact identifier with each evidence row and protect referenced artifacts from deletion.
findings.closureEvidence: E8 check that every restored span equals a slice of a restored document.

findings.title: Contracts and approvals are single-administrator, role-labelled attestations
findings.mechanism: A contract is JSON plus a note of at least 10 characters, stored with reviewer 'admin'. No second reviewer, reference attachment, jurisdiction or dependency field.
findings.falsifier: A stored personal identity or second approval.
findings.correction: Personal identity, two-person rule for contracts and high-impact approvals, reference manifest hash in the contract.
findings.closureEvidence: Schema and route changes with tests on a new candidate.

findings.title: Canonical-graph projection labels auto-published changes as published and public-unpublished ones as reviewed
findings.mechanism: reviewStatus is derived from publication flags, so 'reviewed' does not mean a person reviewed it.
findings.falsifier: A reviewStatus that depends on a recorded review.
findings.correction: Rename or derive from actual review records.
findings.closureEvidence: Projection test on an engine-published change.

findings.title: Hosted implementation identity is build-asserted
findings.mechanism: When source files are absent at runtime the reported hash is the bundled constant.
findings.falsifier: A runtime hash of deployed files.
findings.correction: Keep verifying the deployed archive hash separately and say so wherever the hash is shown.
findings.closureEvidence: Deployment receipt with archive hash for the candidate under test.

findings.title: A hold for high-impact review alone marks the check successful and the policy Available
findings.mechanism: In publish mode the public freshness fields advance while a detected change is unpublished.
findings.falsifier: Not applicable; behaviour is explicit.
findings.correction: Owner to decide the public wording for 'change detected, under review' before O4.
findings.closureEvidence: Recorded decision and matching test.

findings.title: Transport-variant drift may confirm as a change
findings.mechanism: The baseline's transport is not compared with the new capture's. If direct fails and rendered succeeds twice, differences between the two renderings satisfy confirmation.
findings.falsifier: A check that binds transport to the baseline before comparison.
findings.correction: Record and compare transport; hold on a transport change.
findings.closureEvidence: E4 paired direct and rendered captures of the same page.

findings.title: Token-budget check excludes the system instruction and doubles HTTP requests
findings.mechanism: countTokens receives contents only. Negligible at these sizes; relevant only near the limit.
findings.falsifier: Equal counts.
findings.correction: Count the full request or note the margin.
findings.closureEvidence: None required beyond disclosure.

findings.title: Model identity is alias-level
findings.mechanism: The provider returned the alias as modelVersion. Receipts cannot detect a silent revision, and string inequality cannot detect two aliases of one model.
findings.falsifier: A versioned identifier in modelVersion.
findings.correction: Record response date and any provider version metadata; re-run a fixed canary set when behaviour matters.
findings.closureEvidence: Canary receipts dated per trial day.

findings.title: Retained reviewer transcripts are lossy accessibility-tree scrapes
findings.mechanism: Sentences are cut mid-way; inline code and list structure are fragmented.
findings.falsifier: Complete transcripts.
findings.correction: Retain a full-text export alongside the scrape.
findings.closureEvidence: Complete transcript files with hashes.

findings.title: Public summary and risk come from unverified analyst fields
findings.mechanism: The short summary is the first claim; overall risk is the maximum analyst impact; neither is examined by the verifier.
findings.falsifier: Verifier prompt or validator covering impact and ordering.
findings.correction: Decide whether a risk number is published at all for engine changes.
findings.closureEvidence: Owner decision and test.

findings.title: Verifier-side prompt injection untested; model text flows to public page and e-mail
findings.mechanism: The verifier receives the same untrusted documents plus analyst text. No injection has been presented to a working verifier. I did not audit e-mail escaping.
findings.falsifier: Injection negatives with verdicts.
findings.correction: Include verifier-targeted injections in E6; review output escaping.
findings.closureEvidence: E6 injection subset with labels.

findings.title: 15-second transaction ceiling unmeasured for large documents
findings.mechanism: The commit writes snapshot, raw baseline input, diff and canonical graph in one transaction.
findings.falsifier: Commit timings for maximum-size documents on the intended host.
findings.correction: Measure in E7 and Phase B.
findings.closureEvidence: Timing series.
